body.statement: The worked binary selector-gated execution applies the four transition relations in the stated order and emits two canonical models with selector support \(H=\{0,1\}\), the same complete observed law including the independent fair nuisance bits \(W_0,Z_0\), and target probabilities \(1/2\) and \(63/128\). Every listed admissible cell is strictly positive, and the response perturbation at \(t=1/64\) remains inside the response-table simplex.
body.justification: A full trace exposes whether the formal machine can process a real selector gate before producing a legal negative certificate.
body.gap: The prior terminal classification supplied twins but not an execution-level trace through every transition type.
body.consumer: The trace is a regression fixture for exact-arithmetic implementations and for the four-node mediator kill test.
